note: Provenance of the vendored TinyG HIL tables (ROADMAP P0-09, RUN_PLAN §8.2, D32). Every table is byte-identical to what EN-HIL's generator writes. tools/gates/test/schema-tables.test.ts checks each sha256, and packages/schema/test checks each table against vendor/firmware-pins.json. On a firmware bump: regenerate, re-vendor, run `pnpm gen:schema`, and review the diff (CODEOWNERS: owner).
